vector_memory.semantic_summary: This utility module provides core mathematical functions for visibility determination within a rendering pipeline. It implements frustum culling by deriving clipping planes from a projection matrix and testing sphere containment. It also handles bounding volume calculations, specifically generating local bounding spheres for mesh data using a caching mechanism, and transforming these spheres into world space using matrix scaling factors.
